tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribes an email address to the BADideas.fund newsletter for founders. Only use an address the person gave you for this, with their consent.

tools.name: start_deck_upload
tools.description: A step for you, not the founder: gives a one-time link to upload the founder's pitch deck PDF (up to 20 MB) when you have the file. tools.name: submit_pitch
tools.description: Submits a startup's pitch to BADideas.fund, a pre-seed and seed fund for Central and Eastern Europe. Needs the founder's email, their LinkedIn URL, the startup's name and the pitch deck as a PDF (deck_file for a PDF attached in the chat, upload_id from start_deck_upload, or a public deck_url). tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.description: Lists the companies BADideas.fund has backed that it shows publicly: name, one-liner, website, HQ countries (a list; a company with two HQs matches either), month invested (e.g. "Apr 2026") and whether it has exited. Most recent first.

tools.name: search_website
tools.description: Searches BADideas.fund's answers, blog posts and reports for founders (fundraising, pre-seed rounds, CEE startups) and returns the best matches with links.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Asks BADideas.fund's Founder Terminal a founder's question (fundraising, rounds, investors, CEE startups, how the fund invests). tools.name: request_human_answer
tools.description: When ask_question returns outcome not_covered, this asks the BADideas.fund team to write the answer and email it to the founder. Needs the thread_id from ask_question and the founder's email, given by the founder for this.

tools.name: review_deck
tools.description: Reviews a pitch deck PDF the way BADideas.fund's investors read one and returns a written report: score, what works, what to fix, and a link to the full report. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_website, review_deck · Private data: start_deck_upload · Public sink: subscribe_newsletter, start_deck_upload, submit_pitch, request_human_answer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_website, review_deck · Private data: start_deck_upload · Public sink: subscribe_newsletter, start_deck_upload, submit_pitch, request_human_answer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
